# The Travelling Foxes

> > A travel blog documenting adventures across Southeast Asia, with guides to Philippines and Vietnam destinations, cultural experiences, and travel gear reviews.

The Travelling Foxes shares destination guides, accommodation recommendations, and practical travel tips focused primarily on the Philippines and Vietnam. The site covers everything from hiking trails and waterfall tours to heritage walks and pet-friendly dining, helping travelers explore Southeast Asia's diverse landscapes and cultures.

## Key Topics

- Philippines travel
- Vietnam travel
- Southeast Asia destinations
- Manila & Metro Manila
- Sapa & Fansipan
- Adventure travel & trekking
- Island getaways
- Heritage tours
- Travel guides
- Accommodation reviews
- Restaurant guides
- Wearable tech & health tracking
- Travel gear reviews
- Waterfall tours
- Rice terrace trekking

## Philippines Destinations

- [Mt. Daraitan: Your Hiking Questions Answered](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/mt-daraitan-hiking-questions-answered): FAQ guide for hiking Mt. Daraitan & Tinipak River in Tanay, Rizal
- [Top 5 Things To Do In Baguio, Philippines](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/top-5-things-to-do-in-baguio-philippines): Top activities guide for Baguio mountain destination, Philippines
- [Where to Stay in Camiguin: Top Hotels and Accommodations for a Memorable Island Getaway](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/where-to-stay-in-camiguin-top-hotels-and-accommodations-for-a-memorable-island-getaway): Hotel & resort guide for Camiguin Island, Philippines getaway
- [Experience the Enchantment of Can-Umantad Falls in Candijay, Bohol](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/experience-the-enchantment-of-can-umantad-falls-in-candijay-bohol): Travel guide to Can-Umantad Falls waterfall in Candijay, Bohol
- [Siquijor Island: A Haven for Healing and Spiritual Exploration](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/siquijor-island-healing-and-spiritual-exploration): Spiritual healing & traditional healers on Siquijor Island, Philippines
- [Rediscovering Manila's Soul: Why the Escolta Heritage Tour is a Must](https://www.thetravellingfoxes.com/post/rediscovering-manila-s-soul-why-the-escolta-heritage-tour-is-a-must): Heritage tour guide to Escolta's Art Deco architecture & museums

## Vietnam Destinations
